signers.label: Approving Judge
signers.note: Filled automatically at approval — not part of the intake handoff flow.

fields.label: Current Name
fields.prompt: What is your current legal name?

fields.label: Date of Application
fields.note: Auto-fill with today's date when the request is submitted.

fields.label: Discordia Email
fields.prompt: What Discord email/account do you have on file?

fields.label: CID
fields.prompt: Use /cid in city. This will add your CID to your clipboard. Paste that in here please.

fields.label: Legal Representative
fields.prompt: Do you have a legal representative for this request? If so, name them (or answer "None").

fields.label: Requested Name
fields.prompt: What name are you requesting to change to?

fields.label: Reason for Change
fields.prompt: Explain your reason for this name change, including any prior criminal history or outstanding warrants.

fields.label: Joining a Family
fields.prompt: Is this name change to join a family (e.g. taking a family surname)?

fields.label: Family Permission
fields.prompt: Do you have permission from the family to join them under this name? Briefly confirm who granted it.

fields.label: Approving Judiciary
fields.note: Rendered in cursive. Filled in by the bot with the approving judge's on-file signature when the request is approved — never asked of the applicant.

fields.label: Date
fields.note: Auto-fill with today's date when a judge approves the request.
